$Comment: What a job on the Christmas Board pays. Every roll is read on its own: the first always pays, and the
other two are chances on top. Chance is a percent from 0 to 100.
Christmas Coins and festival tokens pay through the Currency reward kind, since a counter wallet has
no item to hand over; favor rides each job's own Rewards. A companion mod adds its own rolls to this
table with a file of its own that names it in ContributesTo, so nothing here has to change.
Name: Christmas_Board_Pay
